title: Reading Drill — Comparing Two Riverbanks
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing Two Riverbanks
passages.body:
**A** A school group recorded vegetation on both sides of a narrow river. Each group set a tape at the same height above the water so the two lines represented comparable levels.

**B** The shadier side had fewer flowers in spring but retained damp ground for longer during dry weeks. The group therefore counted leaves as well as blossoms to compare plant growth.

**C** In summer, it repeated the survey after the grass had been cut. Several differences disappeared, showing that maintenance as well as exposure could influence the comparison.

questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
